files.source.svg: author source SVG (from the paper's arXiv/source bundle)
files.preview.png: PNG render of the author SVG
files.print.png: the figure as extracted from the published PDF, at print size
files.semantics.json: full semantic record for this figure

templates.why_chosen: Numbered layered stack where a dashed orange box marks exactly which sub-tree is the paper's contribution.
templates.what_to_learn: Wrap the contribution in a dashed accent-coloured box inside the stack, and use paired up/down arrows to show a config-down / telemetry-up interface in one place.
